_note: The Urban Sports Club App Catalog, as published. The important and easily-missed fact is that app access is tied to the LENGTH of the membership, not to the tier: a 12-month membership unlocks one app at a time, a 24-month membership two, and a rolling monthly membership none. Corporate memberships (three at a time, and a much longer catalogue) are out of scope for this B2C journey, so the corporate-only apps are not listed here. Logos are the apps' own, loaded live from their own domains; where we do not hold a domain we draw a lettered tile rather than invent a logo.

sources.what: which apps are in the catalogue, and how many you can activate on each membership length

commitmentNote.monthly: The App Catalog comes with a 12- or 24-month membership. On a rolling monthly membership it is not included.
commitmentNote.annual: One app at a time, switchable, included with your 12-month membership.
commitmentNote.biennial: Two apps at a time, switchable, included with your 24-month membership.
